name: Shedding Inhibitions : Dysecdysis
source:
This is a linear visual novel based off the NSFW comic '[url=https://atrolux.itch.io/]Shedding Inhibitions[/url]' by Atrolux, Cloperella, and Carver.

Under the pretense of a casual dinner, Monique tries to free her son from the incestuous clutches of Kyra.

[From [url=https://seftleech.itch.io/shedding-inhibitions-dysecdysis]Itch.io[/url]]

本作是一部線性視覺小說，改編自Atrolux、Cloperella和Carver創作的成人漫畫《[url=https://atrolux.itch.io/]Shedding Inhibitions[/url]》。

莫妮克以吃頓便飯為由，試圖把兒子從凱拉亂倫的魔掌中解救出來。
